title: Biohub P37 Assoc Feature Tap C2 Smoke
purpose: GATE 1, CONTRACT 2. A NEW EXPERIMENT, NOT A RE-VERSION OF P36. P36 (EXP-0043) ran under contract 1 and its archived cache keeps full evidentiary value while losing its training licence (FACT-0410); no legacy read-only mode is admitted, so the pre-fusion surface it never stored cannot be recovered from those bytes and a fresh acquisition is the only route (FACT-0411). This kernel is that acquisition at smoke scale. WHAT IS ALREADY SETTLED AND IS NOT RE-LITIGATED HERE. FACT-0407 re-derived the P36 cache on CPU against the real pack weights and reproduced the GPU verdict to seven digits, then collapsed the gap to ~1e-6 by applying the deployed bidirectional harmonic - so cache FAITHFULNESS on CPU is proven and is not the question. WHAT THIS SMOKE IS FOR, AND IT IS DELIBERATELY NARROW. (1) THE CPU/GPU FLOAT BOUNDARY ON REAL 50-EPOCH WEIGHTS: every parity number we hold was computed on CPU, and the 1e-4 probability / 1e-3 logit tolerances have never been exercised against a T4 forward pass with the deployed trunk. (2) THE CONTRACT-2 SURFACES P36 NEVER RECORDED: the pre-blend primary logits and probabilities as their own columns, band P selected on the pre-blend surface, and the fusion provenance read from the predictor's own locals rather than a log header. Everything else about the tap is unchanged from the artifact that already ran: it is pure insertion into the deployed predict_video, passivity is re-proved from disk in-kernel, the cache is keyed by (pair, role) because a trunk feature is window-dependent (FACT-0402, FACT-0406), and the flush sits between the coordinate concatenate and the deployed rescale at predict_unet_transformer.py:798-802 so the cache holds the downsampled grid the model indexed together with the downsample factor that recovers the original resolution (FACT-0405). Two crops, recording capped at eight frame pairs each. No submission.
